items.title: Jakarta Just Refused Tokyo's Old Trains. Here's Why
items.description:
After watching, you can explain why Jakarta could run Tokyo's retired trains for 25 years without rebuilding its tracks, and why a 20-year import age limit ended that in November 2026.

0:00 Tokyo's trains in Jakarta
0:46 The gift and the bargain
1:53 Why the trains fit
3:37 The 2023 block and new trains
5:08 Too many riders, too few trains
6:24 Back to Tokyo
7:22 The age rule
8:37 What commuters ride next
